summary: Section A establishes the general reporting rules for the 2026 TICO Texas Statistical Plan for Residential Risks, including scope, monthly reporting deadlines, designated statistical agent, claim count/status handling, premium and loss reporting conventions, and required cancellation/nonrenewal/declination reporting. It also defines several Section A code lists and special reporting requirements for TWIA depopulation, private flood coverage, replacement cost and roof coverage type, and reconciliation of actual cancellation/nonrenewal counts to NAIC MCAS data.
